title: Tool, skill and MCP selection from a roster
description: Pick which skill, tool or MCP server from a roster fits a user prompt, or none

roster.description: one {id, description} per skill; pre-filter rosters above 254 (to <= 100)

skill.instructions: Which single skill from the roster, if any, should be loaded for this user prompt?

extra.none: No skill from the roster applies; answer directly without loading any skill

combine: abstain if skill.p < abstain_p; none if skill == 'none'; inject if skill.p >= inject_p; abstain otherwise
limitations: keyword-trap abstention is marginal when a roster topic word appears in a code fix
multi-intent prompts return the dominant skill
overlapping descriptions split probability; ~15 input tokens per option
gate mode (one noul per candidate) and the any_skill_needed pre-gate are not built: use filter or ask
the abstain re-read is the same roster with samples 3, not the top 3 + none
notes: # deviation: spec 5.9: roster is an array of {id, description}; threshold is the inject_p policy (policy_overrides); mode gate is not built
